diagnostics.message: module.eks-addons installs the `adot` add-on, whose own comment states it "requires a cert-manager from helm-addons." cert-manager is provisioned by module.base (base = cert-manager + metrics-server), not by module.ctl. Yet eks-addons only declares `depends_on = [module.ctl]`, so it does not directly depend on module.base where cert-manager actually lives — the ordering is only accidentally satisfied via ctl→base. The cert-manager readiness that adot needs should be expressed directly as a dependency on module.base.
